data.case_title: Copyright infringement warning letter (Abmahnung) from Kanzlei Dr. Beispielmann & Coll.
data.title: Copyright infringement warning letter (Abmahnung)
data.summary: A law firm (Kanzlei Dr. Beispielmann & Coll. Medienrecht) accuses the recipient of sharing a film via a file-sharing network over his internet connection and demands a lump-sum settlement of €1,180.00 (€900 damages plus €280 legal fees), to be paid by 1 December 2026, to avoid being sued.
data.explanation: This is a private law firm's warning letter (Abmahnung) accusing you of illegally sharing a film online, demanding €1,180 by 1 December 2026 instead of going to court. Such letters can be legitimate but also use pressure tactics, and the bank account named here belongs to a person, not the firm, and its IBAN does not pass a standard validity check — both are reasons to be cautious. Before paying, consider getting independent legal advice (e.g. from a consumer advice centre or specialised lawyer) to check whether the claim and the amount are justified. If you do nothing and the claim is valid, the firm says it may proceed with legal action instead.

items.title: Pay the settlement amount (Vergleichsbetrag) to avoid a lawsuit
items.action: Decide whether to pay the demanded €1,180.00 settlement or seek legal advice before the deadline.
items.consequence: The law firm states it will not sue if payment is made by the deadline; if not paid, it may pursue the claim in court.
items.quote: Überweisen Sie den Vergleichsbetrag bis zum 01.12.2026 auf das Konto IBAN DE88 3704 0044 0532 0881 00, Kontoinhaber M. Beispielmann.

key_facts.label: Payment deadline
key_facts.quote: Überweisen Sie den Vergleichsbetrag bis zum 01.12.2026 auf das Konto IBAN DE88 3704 0044 0532 0881 00, Kontoinhaber M. Beispielmann.

warnings: The letter pressures payment by a near-term deadline instead of normal legal process, a common tactic in both legitimate and fraudulent copyright warning letters.
The IBAN given (DE88 3704 0044 0532 0881 00) fails the standard IBAN checksum validation, which is unusual for a professional payment request.

The account holder named for the payment is a private individual ("M. Beispielmann"), not the law firm itself, which is atypical for a lawful settlement payment and should be verified before transferring any money.
Consider getting independent legal advice (e.g. a consumer advice centre or a lawyer) before paying, as file-sharing Abmahnungen have a history of disputed or inflated claims.
